He has been president of the bank since May 2024, executive director since June 2024 and vice chairman of the board since July 2024, and has concurrently chaired Sino-German Bausparkasse since January 2025.

sentences.quote: Mr. Zhang Jinliang has been the Chairman of the bank since March 2024.
sentences.text: Zhang Jinliang has chaired the bank since March 2024, having previously served as president from May 2022 to March 2024, and Zhang Yi became president and vice chairman in 2024 after serving as executive vice president at Bank of China.

Reported results have been steady: 2025 net profit rose 1.04 percent to RMB 339,790 million and total assets grew 12.47 percent to RMB 45,631,818 million, while first-half 2026 net profit rose 5.56 percent with a non-performing loan ratio of 1.29 percent and provision coverage of 238.69 percent.

sentences.quote: operating income was RMB 426.333 billion, and profit before provisions was RMB 328.010 billion, up 10.48% and 13.07% year-on-year respectively; net profit was RMB 171.677 billion, up 5.56% year-on-year
sentences.text: China Construction Bank returned to top-line growth in the first half of 2026, with operating income of RMB 426.333 billion and net profit of RMB 171.677 billion, up 10.48% and 5.56% year on year, helped by a net interest margin of 1.37%, 3 basis points above the full year of 2025.

Capital is a buffer and a growth enabler, with a capital adequacy ratio of 19.42% and core tier-1 ratio of 14.24%, after an A-share issuance to the Ministry of Finance that raised RMB 105.0 billion of Common Equity Tier 1 capital.
Asset quality is stable, with an NPL ratio of 1.29% and allowance to NPL of 238.69%.
Shareholder returns are rising, as the interim dividend of CNY 2.01 per 10 shares lifted the payout ratio to 31% from 30%.
Cost discipline supports returns: the cost-to-income ratio fell 1.55 percentage points to 22.17%.
